import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    amount = df["amount"]
    tax = df["tax"]
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    r1 = amount.isna() | (amount < 0)
    r2 = tax.isna() | (tax < 0)
    r3 = amount.notna() & tax.notna() & (tax > amount * 0.5)
    r4 = due_date.isna()
    r5 = customer_ref.isna() | (customer_ref.astype(str).str.strip() == "")

    codes = []
    for i in range(len(df)):
        parts = []
        if r1.iloc[i]:
            parts.append("AMT_BAD")
        if r2.iloc[i]:
            parts.append("TAX_BAD")
        if r3.iloc[i]:
            parts.append("TAX_EXCESS")
        if r4.iloc[i]:
            parts.append("DUE_NULL")
        if r5.iloc[i]:
            parts.append("REF_EMPTY")
        codes.append("|".join(parts))

    df["reason_codes"] = codes

    is_fail = df["reason_codes"] != ""

    rejects = df[is_fail].copy()
    clean = df[~is_fail].copy()
    clean = clean.drop(columns=["reason_codes"])

    return {
        "invoices_clean": clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "invoices_rejects": rejects.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
